 GoFundMe issues advisory after alleged Summerland scam
 Published 4:44 pm Monday, November 16, 2026
 By Yashvika Grover 
 GoFundMe is asking people to consider certain questions before choosing to donate to a fundraiser. 
 (Pixabay/ Website) 
 Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... 
 GoFundMe is reminding residents to take precautions before donating to a fundraiser after a charity in Summerland was allegedly scammed.
 The charity, New Beginnings Animal Sanctuary Society, posted on Facebook, claiming that a woman raised funds for Bald Range wildfire victims under its name through the GoFundMe platform and refused to give the money raised back to the charity.
 According to the post, the woman went door-to-door under the pretense of raising money for wildfire victims, along with the online fundraising platform she had already set up.
 “When I eventually asked about receiving the donated funds so we could purchase some of the supplies needed to get the mobile ready, I was initially given an explanation about difficulties accessing the money and told it would take another four or five days,” wrote Jane Long-Haggerty, President of New Beginnings Animal Sanctuary Society.
 “When I followed up, the explanation changed. I was then told that the money was needed to cover her expenses, including travel and project management costs, and that this had been disclosed in the GoFundMe description.”
 Since the initial post, the charity has posted multiple updates about the situation, mentioning missing and delayed funds among other things. It has also filed an RCMP report against the person.
 A GoFundMe spokesperson said the website has zero tolerance for the misuse of its platform, “When suspicious activity is flagged—whether through our tools, our community, or simply because a fundraiser starts gaining momentum—our dedicated experts will immediately investigate to verify its legitimacy.”
 The platform asked residents to consider the following questions before donating to a fundraiser:
 How is the organizer related to the intended recipient or organization of the donations?
 What is the purpose of the fundraiser and how will the funds be used?
 Are direct family and friends making donations and leaving supportive comments?
 In the case that answers to these questions are missing from the fundraiser, GoFundMe encourages people to message the organizer by clicking the envelope icon next to their name to ask for more information.
 Consequently, if there are concerns, residents can click the Report fundraiser flag to alert a GoFundMe specialist, who will then investigate the fundraiser.
 “If we need additional information to complete the verification review, our team places a hold on a fundraiser which prevents funds from being withdrawn, pending further review. In the rare instances of misuse of our platform, our team takes swift action, including outright removal of the fundraiser — and in some cases even banning an account for violating our terms of service,” said GoFundMe.
 The platform also guarantees donor protection, so donors can receive a full refund in case a fundraiser is not legitimate.
 More information about tips and safety practices can be found on the GoFundMe website .
